title: PMI/PMBOK: knowledge areas and process groups

videos.script: Large organisations run their projects in a vocabulary of their own. Charter. Baseline. Critical path. Earned value. {{words}} Most of it comes from one book, the PMBOK Guide, published by the Project Management Institute. {{book}} An architect's proposal will be read by people who think in these words. {{proposal}} This lesson teaches the minimum of them, on one small project: the Agenda team's online booking. {{project}} You will break its scope into a tree, find which six activities decide its end date, and read a status report that says over budget and behind schedule as two separate numbers. {{numbers}} Then you will see how the newest edition of the guide changed its mind, from processes to principles, and why that means asking which PMBOK somebody means. {{edition}}
